Chapter 1 of 11

Your moment in. Classic GIF out.

PBgif turns a video or Live Photo into a classic meme GIF in three or four taps. Pick the moment, type a caption, send it.

WHO ATE IT?
I DON'T KNOW

Tap Top text or Bottom text to type, just like the app. The keyboard only shows while you type. Pick a color under the PBgif. Typing stops when the line is full.

Free PBgifs get the flat slice in the corner, 40% see-through. Paid PBgifs can turn it off. A PBgif never gets a second one.

Chapter 3 of 11

The letters are the spread.

PB in peanut butter, gif in grape jelly, squished onto a slice of bread with a toasted rim.

Slide between glossy and flat. Glossy everywhere it can go, shirts too. Flat for screen print.

How small can it go?

Which logo when

Five versions. Pick the one that fits the spot.

1 · MainThe glossy slice.UseThe app icon, the intro, the App Store, big on plain backgrounds.Don'tTiny sizes, busy photos, or printing in one color.
2 · Flat sliceSame slice, no shine.UseSmall sizes, printing, stickers, and the badge on PBgifs.Don'tBig, where the glossy one fits.
3 · Outline sliceThe crust outline and the letters, no bread inside.UseOn photos or colored backgrounds, where a filled slice covers too much.Don'tTiny (the outline disappears), or on very busy photos.
4 · Letters onlyJust the PB and gif letters, flat.UseWide or tight spots like headers and shirts, or when the slice is already showing nearby.Don'tThe app icon, the PBgif badge, or where people don't know PBgif yet.
5 · One colorAll one brand color: Dark Brown, or white on dark.UseOne-color printing, embroidery, stamps, see-through watermarks.Don'tWhen full color is possible.

Every version: never stretch it, only brand colors, no added effects, and always leave space around it.

Chapter 5 of 11

Grape is the jelly. Cream is the bread.

Reading text is Dark Brown. Grape is only for things you can tap. Every color pair is checked so the words are easy to read.

The color of the main button on every screen, like Make a PBgif and Send it. Also the plates, the chosen pill, switches when they're on, and links. If it's the main thing to tap, it's Grape.
What a Grape button turns while your finger is on it. Also the words on light lavender, like the pill choices that aren't picked.
The darker checks of the gingham cloth on the app icon and in the intro. Grape words are still easy to read on it.
The light purple strip behind pill choices like Recent / Most used. The chosen pill is shiny Grape and slides along it. It's also the off side of switches, little labels and soft boxes.
The second choice next to a Grape button, like Make another or Maybe later. Peanut butter and jelly, always together.
The color behind everything in the app, like a slice of bread. Every panel you swipe down is this cream all the way to the edges.
Titles and everything you read. Also the Delete button, the only button with a bite out of it.
Small helper words: notes under things, "Sent 3 times", hints. Softer than reading text, still easy to read.
The light squares of the gingham cloth, and the cards that hold things on the tour and guide pages.

Tap a color to copy its code.

Next The buttons ↓
Chapter 7 of 11

Puffy, drippy, squishy.

Every button is a puffy marshmallow with 0 to 4 short running jelly drips, different every time it shows up. Grape is the jelly, Peanut butter is the PB. Delete gets a bite.

Small round buttons

BackShareDelete

Same colors as the big ones, Apple's icons in white, no drips. Stacked buttons sit 8 pt apart, and a long drip can land on the button below.

Panels you swipe down

Make a PBgif

Every panel you can swipe down wears a glob of peanut butter on its top edge, with a shiny down arrow in it. It sits up 9 pt above the edge and drips over it. Swipe down or tap outside to close.

Tap a button. It squishes. The drips only change when the page loads again. If someone has Reduce Motion turned on in iPhone settings, it just darkens.

Chapter 11 of 11

The house rules.

Ten of them. Tap one to open it.

1Dark Brown for reading, Grape for tapping

Titles and text are Dark Brown. Grape marks only things you can tap.

2The slice wears its toasted rim

Always, on every use of the slice.

3Give it room

A quarter of the slice width on every side. The app icon is exempt.

4Never too small

Never smaller than: slice 48 pt, letters 32, flat 24, typed word 20 (a fingertip is about 44 pt). The badge on free PBgifs is the one exception.

5Letters never on Lavender

The brown letters don't stand out enough there. Use the slice.

6Captions stay inside the lines

One line on top, one on the bottom, edges kept clear. Typing stops when it's full.

7Cloth only where it belongs

App icon, intro and making animation. Never behind PBgifs or reading text.

8Palette only

No made-up colors.

9Errors pop up, good news slides down

Every error is a pop-up with one fix button. Saved is a Dark Brown bar.

10No dark mode

The app looks the same when the phone is set to dark.
